purpose: Outcome-blind observed quote-state support, not price-discovery estimation
authority: User approved systematic pilot; independent CONTRACT_REVIEW permits separately frozen Stage-A projection before main empirical release
environment: SCC only for DBN decode; permitted aggregate counts may return to repository
timestamp_field: ts_recv: interval end; NOT ts_event, which is last trade time in this schema
no_update_rule: No printed record does not mean no valid live quote; this diagnostic reports observed states, not continuous live coverage
partial_file_policy: retain files intersecting the requested window and report full-request containment separately from each observed target; missing padding is not missing all endpoints
baseline: latest observed record strictly before anchor, within input window
endpoint: latest observed record ts_recv <= endpoint, within input window; do not choose latest valid over latest invalid
snapshot_boolean: bid and ask not undefined sentinels, positive prices, positive displayed sizes, ask >= bid; locked counted separately
duplicate_rule: identical observations may collapse; conflicting observations at same instrument/publisher/ts_recv are ambiguous, no arbitrary first/last
age_bin_interpretation: descriptive age of observed interval; not proof of quote freshness or staleness
feed_state: report observed flags; continuity/halt/cancel/gap eligibility remains UNKNOWN unless separately documented
basket_rule: monthly report roster may support membership diagnostics only; no actual-event-basket assertion without date/unit/availability validation
manifest_requirement: exact DBN paths, schema/dataset/publisher scope, header interval and symbol mappings, file sizes, code hash; review before decode
